More about Magnolia Hotel Downtown Dallas

Situated 700 metres from Dallas World Aquarium, Magnolia Hotel Downtown Dallas features a restaurant and free WiFi. Guests can enjoy the on-site bar. Private parking is available on site. Coffee- and tea-making facilities are provided in every room. Certain rooms include a seating area and full kitchen for your convenience. The rooms come with cable TV and a private bathroom. You will find a 24-hour front desk at the property. In the evening, guests are offered complimentary milk and cookies. John Fitzgerald Kennedy Memorial is 700 metres from Magnolia Hotel Downtown Dallas, while Sixth Floor Museum is 800 metres from the property. The nearest airport is Love Field Airport, 9 km from the property.
